requirements: docs/21 Sandbox substrate boundary (immutable, versioned image) / modbit-guest
scenarios: a job-signed root image boots on a real Firecracker MicroVM; forged, tampered and stale images are refused
the same refusals on the reference backend on every OS
proof: Ed25519-signed image manifests: the gateway boots only an image whose manifest verifies under a trusted publisher key, whose bytes hash to what the manifest names (re-checked at every boot) and whose kernel is the one it was built for; the guest that comes up must report the manifest's version and protocol or it is refused at admission; proven on a real MicroVM and on the reference backend.
audit: MISSING before: any image at the configured path booted.
limitations: per-run publisher key in CI; no transparency log.
